title: ashemag/human-atlas
why_read: A well-executed open-source interactive 3D anatomy explorer built on a large public mesh dataset, interesting for both educational and web-graphics engineering reasons.
analysis: This project renders 2,234 selectable BodyParts3D anatomical meshes in-browser with layered views, search, and exploded-view interactions, likely using WebGL/Three.js given the TypeScript stack. Beyond the medical education angle, it's a good showcase of performant 3D web rendering, mesh management, and UI/UX design for complex spatial data. Engineers interested in WebGL, data visualization, or open medical/educational tooling would find this a solid reference implementation.
